main_body: A steel pillar: a rounded capital drum at rows 8-13, a barred shaft with light and dark vertical stripes and light bands at rows 23, 30 and 37, and a base drum at rows 40-47.
top_band: Light steel-blue (L=172) at rows 9-11, then a 1-row lighter line (L=210) at row 12, then a dark underside at rows 13-16. The cap is only about as wide as the shaft plus a pixel or two.
evidence: In the x=8 scan the cap's light run is only rows 9-11 (3 rows). Row 12 (L=210) is a front-edge highlight, and row 13 (L=170) is the same tone as the top, so there is no real step. The cap reads as a horizontal capsule or roll seen face-on with dark dots on its lower edge, not as an elliptical top face of at least 4 rows. The shaft is a flat front view of vertical stripes with horizontal bands, with no visible top surface. The base at rows 40-47 repeats the same face-on band. This matches the guide's flat-band column cap (red) rather than the ellipse cap (green).

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 8 colours per tile against 17-20. 95% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% in the references, which gives the near-black sticker outline. The material ramp is about 4 steps (#c8d4e0, #a4aebb, #5c6472, #2f343e), with a near-black outline and no grain or texture dots. Flat-fill coverage is 0% only because the pieces are small and striped. Overall it is clearly thinner than the Beodeul props.
